welcome_message:
Generating a governed ML/AI product for the Azure AI Platform.

Environment-owned values (workspace hosts, compute policy IDs, run-as client IDs)
are supplied by the platform onboarding tooling. They have no defaults here on
purpose: a product must never carry another environment's identity.

See docs/platform/product-contract.md before onboarding a new product.

project_name.description: Product name in lowercase kebab-case (for example demand-forecasting). Becomes the directory name, the Bundle name and the job name prefix.
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be lowercase kebab-case: start with a letter, then letters, digits or single hyphens (for example demand-forecasting).

schema_name.description: Unity Catalog schema the product owns, in snake_case (for example demand_forecasting). The same schema name is used in every environment; only the catalog differs.
schema_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be lowercase snake_case: start with a letter, then letters, digits or underscores (for example demand_forecasting).

dev_workspace_host.description: DEV Databricks workspace URL, including https://.
dev_workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be an https:// workspace URL with no trailing path.

stg_workspace_host.description: STG Databricks workspace URL, including https://.
stg_workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be an https:// workspace URL with no trailing path.

prod_workspace_host.description: PROD Databricks workspace URL, including https://.
prod_workspace_host.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be an https:// workspace URL with no trailing path.

dev_job_compute_policy_id.description: DEV Databricks compute policy ID governing the product's job cluster.
dev_job_compute_policy_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a Databricks compute policy ID (uppercase hexadecimal).

stg_job_compute_policy_id.description: STG Databricks compute policy ID governing the product's job cluster.
stg_job_compute_policy_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a Databricks compute policy ID (uppercase hexadecimal).

prod_job_compute_policy_id.description: PROD Databricks compute policy ID governing the product's job cluster.
prod_job_compute_policy_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a Databricks compute policy ID (uppercase hexadecimal).

dev_run_as_client_id.description: DEV deployment service principal application (client) ID. The Bundle deploys and runs as this identity.
dev_run_as_client_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a GUID (service principal application ID).

stg_run_as_client_id.description: STG deployment service principal application (client) ID. The Bundle deploys and runs as this identity.
stg_run_as_client_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a GUID (service principal application ID).

prod_run_as_client_id.description: PROD deployment service principal application (client) ID. The Bundle deploys and runs as this identity.
prod_run_as_client_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be a GUID (service principal application ID).

success_message:
Created products/{{.project_name}}.

Next:
  1. Fill in the owner and monitoring sections of the generated README.
  2. Confirm the platform has granted {{.schema_name}} in the dev, stg and prod catalogs.
  3. databricks bundle validate -t dev

The generated product inherits the governed DEV -> STG -> PROD promotion chain.
PROD stays approval-gated; nothing here bypasses it.
